bytedance/seedance-2.5/text-to-video.description: ByteDance's best, and the most expensive clip in the catalog. Here, from a sentence.

pricing.note: fal publishes roughly $0.4730 per second of 720p output and $0.2205 at 480p. 1080p is quoted only as a token rate, $0.0234 per thousand against $0.0214, so its factor is that ratio times the 2.25x pixel count. Its length defaults to auto, which is not a number, so the hold assumes the thirty second ceiling and settle returns what was not used.
